svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Comb: strip 1,050 x 45 mm. Cap: strip 1,050 x 19.5 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (The views show the cap lifted 40 mm above the comb.)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Eleven notches cut down from the comb's top edge, 33 mm deep,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: leaving a 12 mm sill along the bottom. From the centre line:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 40 mm wide (distillate tongues) at 97.2, 291.6, 465 each side;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 60 mm wide (brine tongues) at 0 and 194.4, 390.6 each side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw the notch sides, chop out with a chisel, file square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the comb sits between the side walls, its sill on the same

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: level as the base ring (inside it). The cap sits on the teeth,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: held by two 4 x 30 mm screws into the side walls' end grain.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each plate drops in from above with its tongues in the notches;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the cap closes the notches above the stack.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: every notch 33 mm deep; the cap sits flat on all teeth.
